headline: Measles and School Immunizations — Alaska
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (via CDC Stacks)
blurb: After measles outbreaks in Anchorage and Fairbanks, Alaska set a deadline of March 1, 1977, for all school children to have the shots required by a 1970 state law or be kept out of school.

headline: Measles Outbreak Among School-Aged Children -- Juneau, Alaska, 1996
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Juneau had 63 confirmed measles cases from February 16 through April 25, 1996, and 41 of them were in school-aged children.

headline: Transmission of Measles Among a Highly Vaccinated School Population -- Anchorage, Alaska, 1998
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Health officials counted 33 confirmed measles cases in Anchorage from August 10 through November 23, 1998, including 17 at one high school.

headline: The Epidemiology of Hepatitis A — Alaska, 1973–2016
source: Alaska Section of Epidemiology, State of Alaska Epidemiology Bulletin
blurb: Hepatitis A vaccination became a requirement for daycare and K-12 school attendance in Alaska in 2001, according to this 2017 state health bulletin.

headline: Pertussis Outbreak in the Interior Region ― Alaska, Fall 2014
source: Alaska Section of Epidemiology, State of Alaska Epidemiology Bulletin
blurb: State epidemiologists traveled to a remote community in Alaska's Interior region in October 2014 to investigate a whooping cough outbreak and identified 39 cases.

headline: Notes from the Field: Mumps Outbreak — Alaska, May 2017–July 2018
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: A mumps outbreak that began in Anchorage in May 2017 reached 391 confirmed and probable cases by July 31, 2018, and the state recommended a third dose of MMR vaccine for all Alaska residents.

headline: Measles Confirmed in Southern Kenai Peninsula — What Alaska Clinicians Should Know
source: Alaska Department of Health, Alaska Public Health Alert
blurb: Alaska health officials confirmed measles in an unvaccinated adult from the Southern Kenai Peninsula who started to feel sick while traveling home from a trip overseas.
